regions.today: Isolated showers this evening in light northwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Dry with clear spells at first tonight but cloud will increase overnight and may bring some light rain or drizzle by morning. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 9 degrees with light winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow morning will be cloudy with patches of light rain or drizzle. More persistent rain will develop for a time in the afternoon but will be followed by a clearance to sunny spells and scattered showers by early evening. Highest temperatures of 12 or 13 degrees with light to moderate southwest winds, becoming westerly with the clearance of the rain.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate on Friday and Moderate or Low on Saturday.
